title: Coolant Flow — Minor Deviation
description: Coolant flow P030 = {val} L/min, {val2}% below setpoint. Temperature P031 = {val3} °C. No immediate machining impact.
probable_cause: Minor filter restriction or nozzle partial blockage.
diagnostic_steps: Inspect coolant nozzles for chip blockage
remedy: Clean nozzles. Schedule filter inspection at shift end.
required_action: Log fault. Monitor parameters. Schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.
